About the lab

Senior research in Astro Lab

Students complete a year-long astronomy or astrophysics research project and present the resulting work.

Research process

Develop

Read technical literature, identify a tractable question, and design a research plan with appropriate evidence.

Investigate

Use observations, archives, computation, simulation, or instrumentation while recording choices and uncertainty.

Communicate

Explain methods and conclusions through research writing, posters, talks, and critique from a scientific audience.

For prospective students

Preparing for senior research

Junior students interested in senior research in Astro Lab are encouraged to build their astronomy background through TJ's Advanced Astronomy electives. The electives support later research work with shared scientific context, quantitative methods, and astronomical problem solving.

View the current AA:SS class

Research modes

Methods used in the lab

  • Observational astronomy and calibrated measurement
  • Public survey catalogs, images, spectra, and time series
  • Numerical models and computational astrophysics
  • Instrumentation, automation, and data-quality methods
